name: Banc d'Arguin benthos
description: The invertebrate life of the Banc d'Arguin's tidal flats and seagrass beds: large crustaceans (crabs), molluscs, polychaete worms, small crustaceans, other invertebrates and meiobenthos. Functional group pooling the source's six 'BA' benthic compartments - the resident, habitat-bound guild that recycles detritus and algae into food for the Banc's birds, juvenile fish and mullets; pooled to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling. The source built three scenarios for exactly this biomass because it is so uncertain.
